# Brief — M3: Corner Workflow GUI

> **Status: Completed**

**Files you own:** `ui/workflow.py`, `tools/verify_gui.py` (full), `ui/messages.py` (strings). You consume `rules/engine.py` + `model/` via CONTRACTS — do not edit them; if a contract gap blocks you >2 loops, STOP and log (invariant 6).

## Scope (SPEC §4.2, §11.8.1–§11.8.3)

State machine — one enum, one handler, nothing clever:

    IDLE → PICK_EDGE1 → PICK_EDGE2 → GHOSTS_VISIBLE → SIDE_PICKED(PENDING) → PREVIEW_VISIBLE → CONFIRMED | IDLE(restart)

1. **Edge promotion click flow:** click → screen→world → `rules.promoted_edge_at(...)` → flash promoted edge in highlight color (distinct from deletion red) before ghosts. Esc/right-click anywhere → back to IDLE, no partial state survives.
2. Ghost previews (2, one per side) from `place_corner` with both `Side` values; ghost = dashed outline arc + candidate circle. Click a ghost → that `Side` feeds the real `place_corner`.
3. **Deletion preview = auto-zoom** to corner window (4× diameter) + summary text EXACTLY: `Deleting: N LINE, N ARC — Trimming: N — Flagged: N CIRCLE, N MTEXT` + reasons. Thick red for delete/trim. Flagged entities (CIRCLE/MTEXT/chord-crossers): prompt per SPEC §11.5-amended flow — first occurrence prompt yes/no; decision persisted via `model.flag_decisions[eid]` (sticky per session; recompute honors existing decisions — no re-prompting; ADR-009).
4. Same edge twice → immediate inline message, stay in PICK_EDGE2.
5. Apex gate / shallow-angle / overlap refusals: toast + status line with the engine's `refusals` strings verbatim. No reinterpretation in UI.

## DoD

- `tools/verify_gui.py --full`: drives all three sample corners corner-to-corner via synthetic events (two edge clicks, ghost click, confirm), asserts final `ModelState` (dogbone count, deletions, rebuilt endpoints) against SAMPLES.md golden blocks
- Human visual checklist: ghosts both visible; promoted-edge flash distinguishable; auto-zoom framing correct; refusal toasts appear (force one by clicking two parallel lines)
- `pytest -q` green (UI state machine unit-tested headless by construction: handlers take (state, event) → new state, canvas-free)
- Session log + ISSUES.md M3 row (single writer)

**Cite:** SPEC §4.2, §11.5, §11.7, §11.8; CONTRACTS §1 (`CornerResult`, `Model.apply_corner`), §2, §5; ADR-001, ADR-005, ADR-007 cut list.
